specialRules.name: Reactive hull
specialRules.description: Brace: save 2+, armour 4+. Repairs: 4+. Check faction rules for environmental immunities and save exceptions.

specialRules.name: Inertialess drive
specialRules.description: All ahead full: +D6 × 10 cm; turn every 20 cm. Weapons remain halved.

specialRules.name: Lightning arcs
specialRules.description: Battery rules; targets count as closing. Ignore holofield/shadowfield column shifts. Divide firepower between listed arcs.

specialRules.name: Fade out
specialRules.description: Automatic disengagement after movement. Consult faction rules for victory-point penalties and campaign restrictions.

specialRules.name: Stealth and sensors
specialRules.description: While uncrippled, does not trigger orbital mines or give enemies a Command bonus for its orders. Any uncrippled Shroud grants the fleet an extra +1 Command bonus when an enemy is on orders.
